title: 第一卷 第6章 那是我和她的秘密
novel_title: 重回九八：我在小渔村兴风作浪
content_zh:
来到张海洋的摊位。

    就在隔壁。

    张海洋收的货明显比其他摊贩少很多，他年轻，也是刚开始干这生意，没什么客户。

    把水桶里的蛏子倒出来，他是越看越欢喜：“都好大只啊。”

    “怎么挖到的？”

    “不是挖到人家养的塘里吧？”

    李华说道：“你不信我，还信不过你堂妹？”

    “什么价格？”

    张海洋说道：“一斤七块钱。”

    李华眉头一皱。

    觉得太便宜了。

    后世这么大的蛏子，搞了个蛏子王的噱头，单价能卖到三位数一斤，但想想这年头，累死累活忙活一个月也就能挣个百十来块钱。

    这价格也就合理了。

    李华点点头，挑出能炒一盘的蛏子，然后看向方林：“行了，这些都卖。”

    张海洋指着青蟹说道：“青蟹我能给到二十五块钱一斤。”

    李华：“青蟹不卖。”

    张海洋：“你要是觉得价格……”

    李华：“和价格没关系，要拿回家给家人吃。”

    张海洋一听，无奈的点点头：“行吧。”

    蛏子过秤。

    一共是二十二斤。

    张海洋把蛏子放好，拿一百五十四块钱交给李华。

    李华接过钱，点出来77元递给张春妮，张春妮后退一步，连忙摆手，说道：“不用……不用给我。”

    “你拿去……拿去还债吧。”

    李华没废话，直接抓住张春妮的手，将钱拍在她掌心里，然后帮她把手掌合拢，做完这些还不撒手，就这么抓着她的手，说道：“拿好。”

    “我欠的钱，用不着你操心。”

    “我有的是办法搞钱还上。”

    张春妮家里非常困难，奶奶年纪大经常生病需要人照顾，她没办法去外面打工，只能在码头做些零工，赚的钱还不够医药费。

    能细支结硕果，除了她天赋异禀以外，主要还是因为太瘦了。

    他亏欠张春妮那么多，这点钱不算什么，只是最微不足道的补偿。

    慢慢来。

    他会帮着张春妮把日子越过越好。

    张春妮脸通红，慌张的把手藏到身后，她都要急哭了，这人怎么回事，大庭广众之下抓她的手。

    还那么用力。

    捏的她好疼。

    她也不敢吭声，只能咬着嘴唇，低下头。

    一旁。
content_en:
Came to Zhang Haiyang’s stall.

    Just next door.

    Zhang Haiyang's collection of goods is obviously much less than that of other vendors. He is young and has just started in this business and has few customers.

    Pouring out the razor clams from the bucket, he became more and more delighted as he looked at them: "They are all so big."

    "How did you dig it?"

    "Isn't it dug into someone else's pond?"

    Li Hua said: "You don't believe me, but you can't believe your cousin?"

    "What price?"

    Zhang Haiyang said: "Seven yuan per catty."

    Li Hua frowned.

    I think it's too cheap.

    In later generations, razor clams of this size were used as a razor clam king gimmick, and the unit price could be sold for three digits per pound. But think about it these days, you can only earn about a hundred or ten yuan a month after working so hard.

    The price is reasonable.

    Li Hua nodded, picked out a plate of razor clams, and then looked at Fang Lin: "Okay, I'll sell these."

    Zhang Haiyang pointed at the blue crabs and said, "I can give you twenty-five yuan a pound for blue crabs."

    Li Hua: "Blue crabs are not for sale."

    Zhang Haiyang: "If you think the price..."

    Li Hua: "It has nothing to do with the price. I want to take it home and feed it to my family."

    Upon hearing this, Zhang Haiyang nodded helplessly: "Okay."

    The razor clams are weighed.

    A total of twenty-two pounds.

    Zhang Haiyang put away the razor clams and handed them to Li Hua with 154 yuan.

    Li Hua took the money, counted out 77 yuan and handed it to Zhang Chuni. Zhang Chuni took a step back, waved her hand quickly and said, "No... don't give it to me."

    "Take it...take it to pay off your debt."

    Li Hua didn't waste any time. He directly grabbed Zhang Chuni's hand, slapped the money into her palm, and then helped her close her palms. After doing this, he didn't let go. He just grabbed her hand and said, "Take it."

    "You don't need to worry about the money I owe."

    "I have plenty of ways to get money to pay it back."

    Zhang Chunni's family is very difficult. Her grandmother is old and often sick and needs care. She has no way to work outside and can only do odd jobs at the dock. The money she earns is not enough for medical expenses.

    Apart from her extraordinary talent, the main reason why she can achieve great results is because she is too thin.

    He owed Zhang Chuni so much, this little money was nothing, just the most insignificant compensation.

    Take your time.

    He will help Zhang Chunni make her life better.

    Zhang Chunni's face turned red and she hid her hands behind her back in a panic. She was about to burst into tears. What happened to this man? He grabbed her hand in public.

    Still so hard.

    It hurt her so much to pinch.

    She didn't dare to say anything, so she could only bite her lip and lower her head.

    aside.
title_en: Volume 1 Chapter 6 That’s the secret between me and her
